We think outside the box, always scouting for new ideas for implementation and collaboration with our customers. Our business models are flexible in order to ensure optimal engagement with our customers. Our two common business models are service-based and partnership: Service-Based model RTC Vision offers customer-specific services that are designed to address specific problems and needs. These services may include conducting a feasibility study or proof-of-concept (POC) to determine the viability and details of a project, developing algorithms, implementing, and customizing solutions, and optimizing and deploying the final product. By beginning with a limited feasibility study or POC, we can define the project in detail and mitigate any potential risks before moving forward with the full project. Partnership model In addition to the service-based model, we are open to various modes of partnership. With a broad portfolio of capabilities and technologies designed for various industries, we enhance our customers’ products by deploying our engines, technologies, and know-how. We are experienced in tailoring the model to create a win-win collaboration. Licensing model – When we provide the core engines and can show that they solve the customers’ crucial problems and significantly shorten the development time. Equity model – For long-term partnerships where RTC Vision shares part of the risks, we are open to models where part of the compensation is done by equity or stock options. This model might be attractive to some small and start-up companies. Entrepreneurship initiatives – We embrace entrepreneurs and are experienced in helping to grow and maturing breakthrough ideas, not only from the technology perspective but also from aspects such as market analysis, product, and raising funds. RTC Vision successfully spun-out successful startup companies (e.g. Kitov.ai). jobs.title: Technologies
jobs.description: Technologies - RTC Vision Home Company Business Solutions Technologies Markets Sample Projects Mazor Robotics Sarine Kitov Kutz Picodya Launchpad Blog Careers Contact Us Home Company Business Solutions Technologies Markets Sample Projects Mazor Robotics Sarine Kitov Kutz Picodya Launchpad Blog Careers Contact Us Technologies RTC Vision delivers cutting edge solutions that stem from hands-on industry experience, independent research and academic knowledge. We approach every project with a detailed analysis of all challenges, and tailor optimal solutions with smart and efficient design. Our vast experience and continuous exploration drive RTC Vision to a leadership position in Computer Vision, and AI technology. Deep/Machine Learning In recent years, Deep Learning has become an increasingly important tool for solving many challenges in Computer Vision. RTC offers effective solutions to complex classification and detection challenges by combining AI and Deep Learning with classical Computer Vision. DL technologies and techniques used at RTC include convolutional neural networks (CNN), generative adversarial networks (GAN), transformers, autoencoders, cascade decisions, data augmentation, transfer learning, and dimensionality reduction. RTC uses standard libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Keras. This enables our code products to be easily integrated into various platforms, such as PCs, servers, and Android devices. 3D Technologies RTC's 3D technology focuses on the geometric processing and modeling of 3D objects. We provide high-quality 3D reconstruction for various applications such as computed tomography, diamond structure evaluation, electronic assemblies, and terrain analysis. We operate in various challenging situations, including adverse acquisition conditions, limited or missing 2D projection data, and handling large amounts of data. RTC's capabilities include multi-view geometry, panoramic and mosaic image composition, tomographic imaging, passive and active vision such as structure light and time-of-flight technologies, 3D object registration in noisy environments, bundle adjustment approaches to multiple-view calibration of RGB and depth devices, and scene reconstruction. Our unique tools and software modules, coupled with RTC Vision's customization and implementation capabilities, deliver reliable, tailor-made, high-quality solutions. Advanced image processing RTC technology offers a comprehensive suite of advanced image-processing solutions for images, videos, and 3D volume imaging. Our models can handle images and videos taken under the most adverse conditions. We provide robust methods for image enhancement, multi-modal image registration, image fusion, and super-resolution-based image reconstruction, to name a few. Over the years, RTC technology has proven to be highly efficient, configurable, and reliable in numerous applications. Our unique methodology enables easy and smooth integration of our advanced toolset into various applications in diverse markets, including industrial, medical, forensics, and security markets. Medical imaging Over the last decade, RTC Vision has been applying its outstanding expertise in computer vision and image processing to innovative technological solutions in medical imaging. In this complex interdisciplinary field, a high level of algorithmic knowledge is needed in combination with precise physical modeling and formulation capabilities. Machine vision and AI algorithms are essential components of many medical imaging applications, such as image/volume reconstruction and enhancement, registration, detection, semantic segmentation, simulation, and data augmentation. Our experts tackle these multiple challenges by inverse problem formulation, numerical optimization, adaptive modeling, and deep learning networks specifically designed for medical imaging purposes. RTC Vision has accumulated vast experience in different imaging modalities, medical protocols, standards, and physical modeling of acquisition devices. Visual Quality Inspection RTC is actively involved in developing product quality control applications across a wide range of industries and manufactured goods, from 2D and 3D structural analyses of parts at assembly lines to an in-depth evaluation of raw materials (e.g., diamonds). RTC Vision's partners and clients benefit from our diverse technical portfolio and vast experience in designing deep-learning neural networks and adaptable algorithmic tools for advanced image-processing techniques, precise calibration methods, and statistical models to identify and classify defects by type, scope, scale, and severity. We place great emphasis on sensor and platform optimization in our visual inspection designs to ensure our products' affordability, precision, and efficiency. Robotics The recent advances in automation and robotics have opened new horizons for Computer Vision and AI technologies. Robotic systems perform more and more tasks, including complex medical procedures, vehicular operations, 3D product assembly, and large-scale construction. RTC Vision has an outstanding proven record of designing and developing reliable products for various applications, including hand-eye calibration, semantic understanding, and path-planning technologies; our algorithm-based products are intended to compensate for or overcome different extraneous obstructions and environmental factors. jobs.description: Mazor Robotics - RTC Vision Home Company Business Solutions Technologies Markets Sample Projects Mazor Robotics Sarine Kitov Kutz Picodya Launchpad Blog Careers Contact Us Home Company Business Solutions Technologies Markets Sample Projects Mazor Robotics Sarine Kitov Kutz Picodya Launchpad Blog Careers Contact Us SAMPLE PROJECT Mazor Robotics specializes in the development and marketing of innovative surgical robots and complementary products that redefine the field of medical surgery. “RTC Vision has been a trusted Mazor partner since 2005. Able to handle the challenges of our product development life cycle, from algorithm development to implementation, RTC overcame even the toughest technological obstacles. The RTC team takes on bold challenges and delivers what they promise – innovative, professional, and high-quality results.” Eli Zehavi, COO & VP R&D Mazor Robotics, Ltd. The Challenge Mazor sought a viable technological solution that would enable intra-operative conversion of 2D x-ray scans into rotatable 3D images and which would be based on the standard C-Arm imaging system available in most operating rooms. The Solution RTC Vision partnered with Mazor Robotics to develop C-InSight ®, an innovative, intuitive, and cost-efficient apparatus allowing to generate a detailed view of intra-articular surfaces in high-quality 3D images with minimal artifacts by implants and significantly lower radiation exposure (5-10% compared to alternative intraoperative 3D scanning methods), making it safer for both surgeon and patient. C-InSight ® is CE and FDA-approved. Prev Previous Launchpad Connect with us today We look forward to hearing from you RTC Vision Lev Haaretz Park, Tevet Building, B Entrance P.O. jobs.title: Launchpad
jobs.description: Launchpad - RTC Vision Home Company Business Solutions Technologies Markets Sample Projects Mazor Robotics Sarine Kitov Kutz Picodya Launchpad Blog Careers Contact Us Home Company Business Solutions Technologies Markets Sample Projects Mazor Robotics Sarine Kitov Kutz Picodya Launchpad Blog Careers Contact Us SAMPLE PROJECT The Launchpad platform is a combined software and hardware system for manufacturing products in fast turnarounds. The software automatically analyzes, classifies, routes, and plans product procurement, manufacturing, and assembly.​ “It has been a pleasure to work with RTC-vision on successful projects and demos. In terms of quality, consulting, and innovative thinking, it was exactly what we were looking for in a technology vendor. Highly recommended!” Ofer Ricklis The Challenge Product assemblage includes tasks such as fastening, glue dispensing, picking, and placing, which are carried out using a robot equipped with appropriate tools. Ensuring a seamless operation throughout the assembly chain requires high precision regarding component placements and the spatial definition per task (the location where a task begins and ends). The system, therefore, uses a camera for detection, analysis, and robot guidance, which in turn requires precise spatial analysis and object/part classifications using complex algorithmic processing. The Solution Provided a CAD model or image of a specific part, the analytic algorithms we have developed allow precise and expedient camera-image processing of the location, position, and orientation of any given part on a 3D spatial matrix to facilitate seamless, high-volume performance along the assembly line.
